title: How to Train Your Dragon
description: A young Viking forms an unexpected friendship with a dragon and begins to question everything his village believes.
overview: Hiccup, an inventive Viking who does not fit the expectations of his community, encounters a dragon named Toothless. As their bond grows, Hiccup discovers that dragons may not be the enemies everyone assumes, challenging generations of tradition and opening the door to a different future.

title: Gladiator
description: A respected Roman general is betrayed and forced to fight for survival while seeking justice.
overview: After a political betrayal destroys his life, Roman general Maximus is taken far from home and becomes a gladiator. His skill and resolve make him a celebrated fighter, while he remains determined to confront the corruption that took everything from him.

title: Thunderbolts*
description: A team of complicated outsiders is brought together for a mission that tests their trust and their past choices.
overview: When a group of unconventional operatives find themselves caught in a dangerous situation, they must work together despite clashing personalities and difficult histories. The mission pushes them to reconsider what makes someone a hero and whether they can rely on one another.

title: Knives Out
description: A famous detective investigates a wealthy family's secrets after the death of its celebrated patriarch.
overview: After the death of a successful mystery novelist, detective Benoit Blanc is called to investigate the circumstances surrounding the event. As he questions the family and those close to the household, conflicting stories and hidden motives turn the case into a clever puzzle.

title: Mission: Impossible – The Final Reckoning
description: Ethan Hunt and his team race against time as a global threat puts the future at risk.
overview: Ethan Hunt faces one of his most consequential missions as he and his allies try to stop a powerful threat with worldwide consequences. Their choices demand trust, sacrifice, and determination as the team works to prevent a catastrophe.

title: Puss in Boots: The Last Wish
description: Puss in Boots sets out on a magical quest to restore his lost wishes while learning to value the life he has.
overview: After discovering that he has used up most of his legendary lives, Puss in Boots begins a journey to find the mythical Wishing Star. Joined by old friends and new companions, he faces rivals and fears that lead him to rethink what matters most.

title: Spider-Man: No Way Home
description: Peter Parker asks for help after his identity becomes public, but the solution brings unexpected consequences.
overview: With his private life turned upside down, Peter Parker seeks a way to make the world forget that he is Spider-Man. When the plan goes wrong, he must face extraordinary visitors and make difficult choices about responsibility, friendship, and what it means to be a hero.

title: The Bad Guys
description: A group of notorious animal outlaws attempts to change its reputation through an ambitious plan.
overview: After years of being known as the city's most feared animal criminals, a crew of outlaws tries to pull off one last scheme. Their plan becomes more complicated as they discover that changing how others see them may require changing how they see themselves.

title: The Truman Show
description: A cheerful man begins to suspect that the carefully arranged world around him is not what it seems.
overview: Truman Burbank lives what appears to be an ordinary, pleasant life in a picture-perfect town. Gradually, strange coincidences make him question his surroundings, leading him to investigate the truth behind the world he has always known.

title: Whiplash
description: A driven young drummer pushes himself to excel under the demanding guidance of a formidable music instructor.
overview: Andrew, an ambitious jazz drummer, earns a place in a prestigious music conservatory ensemble led by an intensely demanding instructor. As the pressure to achieve greatness increases, Andrew must consider the personal cost of pursuing perfection.

title: Wicked
description: Two very different students form an unexpected friendship in the magical Land of Oz.
overview: At Shiz University, Elphaba and Glinda begin as unlikely companions whose differences gradually shape a deep friendship. Their paths change after an encounter with the Wizard of Oz, setting them on journeys that challenge their beliefs, ambitions, and ideas of good and evil.
